notes.title: Testing is over and we're ready for release
notes.notes:
If there is anyone out there D:

There was quite a bit of feedback and I'm proud to say that all reported issues have been fixed. There's no doubt that there will be more issues (no game is bug free).

I'd just like to say thank you to all the testers. Last but not least, everyone that's been part of this journey while developing this game. Friends, family, puppies and cats... You all rock. <3
